description: Write to somebody, as you. A username reaches them on this instance and is free; a full email address leaves over SMTP under this instance's domain, so a reply comes back to your inbox, and is charged. Resolve a name with contacts_find first. Mail that leaves needs MAIL_DOMAIN configured on the instance

to.description: Recipient: a username on this instance, or a full email address. Resolve a name with contacts_find first
